items.title: Orrin Evans interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018
items.q: people like Bobby Watson and Ralph Peterson, Ralph Bowen and all these, Shirley Scott, Trudy Pitts, just people that I was around in the neighborhood.

ctx.x: There’s a certain etiquette to a jazz performance. Can you learn that in jazz school?

It depends on who you’re learning from you know. I mean when you think about people who teach the business of music, if there is a course offered wherever you are and they have a business of music course, sometimes it’s taught by someone who had four gigs before they got that position. You know? And sometimes it’s taught by someone who’s © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-

had, you know, a touring career already. So they can share things that the other person didn’t know, or doesn’t know. So really it just depends on who you’re learning from in school. Now if you’re out in the world, because I always say I went to the university of the streets. Because I went to Rutgers University but I learned so much from just playing and being a part of the scene and from people like Bobby Watson and Ralph Peterson, Ralph Bowen and all these, Shirley Scott, Trudy Pitts, just people that I was…
